Download nuget artifacts

Download the .nupkg of a package version. rp does what a NuGet client does: it
reads the service index (GET &lt;repo&gt;/v3/index.json), takes the PackageBaseAddress
resource from it (the address is never built by rp), lists the versions
(GET &lt;base&gt;/&lt;id&gt;/index.json), picks one (--version, default the highest release,
else the highest pre-release) and downloads
&lt;base&gt;/&lt;id&gt;/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;id&gt;.&lt;version&gt;.nupkg: three requests.

The id is matched in lower case and the version as NuGet compares versions, so
1.0 and 1.0.0 are the same version. The file is stored as &lt;id&gt;.&lt;version&gt;.nupkg,
both lower case, with the version as the server lists it. The flat container
publishes no checksum, so the file is stored but reported as not verified.

A repository whose service index has no PackageBaseAddress resource is refused
with a message that names it.

```
rp download nuget <id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --dir string       Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --force            Replace the file when it already exists
      --repo string      Repository to download from (required)
      --version string   Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
